cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Could you leave quiz night for your sister's first exhibition opening?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm captain. They'll think I've abandoned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Tell them your sister needs you. I'd like that to outrank geography.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave after round one and say I've got a headache.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come after round one, but tell them it's for me. I want to rank above geography, not below a headache.

mechanism: A approves a limited schedule compromise only if the public reason acknowledges the relationship as the true priority.
confusable: Simply getting attendance would miss D35; A must seek a rearrangement that visibly proves relationship priority rather than an unrelated excuse.
comparison: A sibling exhibition and quiz captain obligations differ from private haircut rescheduling and a cancellation fee.
seedUse: The existing D35-b final conditional permission already joins S01 ranking with approval of a relationship-priority compromise.
